Yes — Ramapo has a recommended graduation plan for the Computer Science BS. Using the Fall 2026 cohort plan (for students admitted during the 2026–2027 academic year), the suggested freshman schedule is: Fall: CMPS 147 Computer Science I, MATH 110 Precalculus, INTD 101 First Year Seminar, and CRWT 102 Critical Reading and Writing II. Spring: CMPS 148 Computer Science II, MATH 121 Calculus I, CMPS 220 Assembly Language Programming, one General Education course, and PATH 001 Career Pathways Mod 1. The same plan notes that CRWT and math are determined by placement testing and should follow that sequence. It also says general education courses can be taken in any order except INTD 101, CRWT, and math; First Year Seminar is taken in the first semester. [Recommended Graduation Plans](https://www.ramapo.edu/recommended-graduation-plan-2026/snh/computer-science/)

Recommended plans are cohort-specific and don’t replace advising or the catalog requirements. I used the Fall 2026 Computer Science BS plan because you didn’t mention your start year; if you tell me when you started at Ramapo, I can match the exact cohort plan. [Recommended Graduation Plans](https://www.ramapo.edu/recommended-graduation-plan-2026/snh/computer-science/)
